EnvId.description:
Identifies one materialisation of a unit. A unit re-materialised after reclaim
gets a new environment, not a new unit.

EnvName.description: The name of an environment variable, as it appears left of `=` in a dotenv file.

HostName.description: The name of a host a unit can live on.

Missing.description:
A declared name that activation could not fill.

A missing name is a line of a report, never a failure: a working copy of a project
whose mail credential is absent still runs everything that does not send mail.

want.description: Which list of the recipe declares it.

Origin.description:
Who supplied an environment variable's value.

The order of the variants is the order the resolver tries: a name a unit generated
for itself beats the same name in a machine-wide file, because a generated value is
bound to resources only this unit has.

oneOf.description: Nodal itself: the `NODAL_*` variables that say which unit this is.
A value the unit minted for its own services: a port, a URL, a database role.

ProjectName.description: A project's display name, taken from its directory or its remote.

Slug.description: The CLI handle for a unit, derived from its branch.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant, serialised as an RFC 3339 string.

UnitId.description: Identifies a `WorkUnit`. Stable for the life of the work, across machines.

Want.description: Why a declared name has no value.

oneOf.description: The recipe declares it under `env.generated` and no service produced it.
The recipe declares it under `env.secrets` and no secret source has it.
The recipe declares it under `env.required_local` and no source has it.

description: `.nodal/manifest.toml`: what this home is, and which names it was activated with.

env.description: Every name `.nodal/env` assigns, and who supplied it. Names only.

home.description: The home directory this file sits in.

host.description: The host that holds this copy.

project.description: The project the unit belongs to.

unit.description: The unit this home is a materialisation of.
